title: Hotel booking form: dates, guest steppers, room type, special requests — The Linden Hotel
notes: v1 is a hand-written BEM booking page (date inputs with arrival_date/departure_date, +/- steppers labelled 'Add adult', <article> room cards with radios, a <dl> price summary). v2 is a React rebuild with StyleX atomic classes (x1abc23d ...): the dates move into an <lh-date-range> declarative shadow root (labels 'Arrive'/'Depart', names checkIn/checkOut), guests become a list of rows with 'Increase adults'/'Decrease adults' icon buttons (Infants added), room cards become whole-card <label>s sorted by price descending with slug values, special requests move up into a new 'Make it special' section, and the summary becomes div rows. Decoys: identical icon-only stepper buttons for children and infants, a sticky mobile bar repeating the £1,213.80 total and a second 'Reserve' button, a header 'Book a room' link.

targets.description: Icon-only '+' button that adds an adult guest
'Book now' submit button in the stay summary
Total price (£1,213.80) in the stay summary
